name: חִזְקִי
summary: A Benjamite, son of Elpaal, in the list of the heads of fathers' houses of Benjamin who dwelt in Jerusalem (1Ch 8:17–18). The name is spelled as the noun חֵזֶק “strength” with “my”, the very form of Psa 18:2, “I love you, Yahweh, חִזְקִי”; it may be a short form of Hezekiah, “Yahweh is my strength”.

evidence.note: “Ishmerai, Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal.”
“I love you, Yahweh, חִזְקִי”: the same word.

note: Takes h.bs.ah (1 token). The reading as a short form of חִזְקִיָּהוּ is a lead from the form, not stated in scripture.
